hook: Even under siege, a mountain yields four foods without any farming.

word.note: It refers to the foods that grow naturally on Pari's hill without the labor of farmers during the siege.

excerpt: How worthy of pity is Pari's Parampu hill! Even if the three kings with loud war drums besiege it, it yields four kinds of food that farmers do not cultivate. First, the small-leaved bamboos ripen with bamboo rice. Second, the sweet-pulped jackfruit matures. Third, the lush-vined yams grow deep tubers. Fourth, when beautifully colored black monkeys leap and break open the hives from above, the solid, towering hill pours down honey.
